summary: Phase 5 (Substack-style essays) backend testing complete. 94/94 pytest cases pass (100%). 24 NEW Phase 5 tests added in /app/backend/tests/test_phase5_essays.py covering (a) short-post regression (kind defaults to 'post', 500-char limit, status pending_release, release_at > created_at in next 8:30/17:30 CT window); (b) essay create happy path returns post_id + kind=essay + status=approved + release_at == created_at (instant release); (c) essay validation - missing title -> 422 'Essays require a title', empty/whitespace title -> 422, body < 100 chars -> 422 'Essays must be at least 100 characters', body == 50000 chars OK, body > 50000 -> 422, unapproved user (needs_application) -> 403; (d) Follower email dispatch: seeded writer W with two followers F1/F2 both status=approved, posted essay via /api/posts, polled db.essay_dispatches up to 5s for BackgroundTask completion, asserted exactly 2 rows with distinct recipient_user_id == {F1, F2}; (e) Idempotency: created essay (1 follower), waited for BG task to write 1 dispatch row, then directly imported and awaited services.essay_dispatch.dispatch_essay_to_followers(db, post_id) - returned sent=0 skipped=1 and final row count remained 1, confirming the unique index on (post_id, recipient_user_id) prevents double-insert; (f) GET /api/essays/{post_id} for approved member returns full body in 'text', paywall=false, kind=essay, title, subtitle, image_path, created_at, release_at, is_pete_pick, is_released=True, reply_count, full author={user_id,name,market,avatar_path,is_supporter}; unauthenticated returns paywall=true, NO 'text' key, 'preview' present and len <= 325 chars, still includes title/subtitle/author/image_path; non-member (status=needs_application) -> paywall=true; admin-hidden essay -> 404; suspended author -> 404 (unsuspended in finally to avoid leaking state); short 'post' kind id -> 404 (essays-only endpoint); unknown post_id -> 404. (g) Feed payloads (/api/posts/public, /api/posts/feed, /api/posts/mine, /api/posts/by-user/{id}) include essay items with kind='essay' + 'preview' field and intentionally OMIT the full 'text' field; title and subtitle are preserved. (h) Pete pick on essay works: admin can POST /admin/posts/{id}/pick on an essay, /api/posts/picks lists it with kind=essay; admin unpick works. Phase 1 (27), Phase 2 (5), Phase 3 (23), Phase 4 (15 - one assertion updated to match new tiers schema), and Phase 5 (24) all green.

minor.issue: Response schema changed from single price_usd/period_days fields to a 'tiers' array (monthly $10 / yearly $100) to support the unchanged Global $10/mo + $100/yr spec. Phase 4 test_subscription_default_not_supporter was asserting the old shape (price_usd==19) and started failing. Test updated to assert the new tiers shape. No production bug - the API is internally consistent and the new shape is correct per spec, but consumers of the old shape would break. Flagging because the test_credentials and Phase 4 baseline expected the old shape.

PREVIEW_CHARS in /api/essays/{post_id} uses limit 320 (essays.py) while /api/posts/feed et al use ESSAY_PREVIEW_CHARS=320 in posts.py. Both are 320 today but two separate constants - consider centralizing in a config module to keep them in sync.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/posts.py:PostCreate.model_validator - essay validation strips title/subtitle only for kind=='post' but silently nullifies them. Consider returning a 422 instead of nullifying to avoid surprising clients who passed a title.

routes/posts.py:_attach_meta - for essay items it pops 'text' and inserts 'preview'. Older clients reading feeds and expecting 'text' on every item will break. Documented behavior but worth highlighting in API changelog. Verified all 4 feed endpoints (/public, /feed, /mine, /by-user/{id}) behave consistently.

routes/essays.py:get_essay - the suspended-author check uses owner.get('suspended') truthy. Combined with status filter {$nin:['declined','hidden']} the essay is hidden for any suspended author. Correct. However if an admin views as themselves, suspended-author essays still 404 (admin override is NOT implemented for essay reader). Phase 3 admin moderation pattern allows admins to see hidden content elsewhere - consider parity for essays.
routes/essays.py:get_essay - PREVIEW_CHARS constant lives twice (posts.py + essays.py). Refactor into services/text.py to keep paywall preview length consistent if it ever changes.

services/essay_dispatch.py:dispatch_essay_to_followers - filters followers by status=='approved' AND suspended != true. Good. The followers list is .to_list(5000) - hard cap. For high-follower writers > 5000 this silently truncates. Consider an async cursor with batching to handle the edge case, or surface a warning in logs.

services/essay_dispatch.py - inserts the dispatch row AFTER send_essay_email returns. If Brevo call succeeds but the insert fails (DB transient error), a duplicate send could occur on retry. Acceptable given the unique compound index guards subsequent attempts; but Brevo would have already shipped one email. Consider inserting the dispatch row FIRST (status='pending') then update with the Brevo result - safer for at-most-once-email semantics.
services/essay_dispatch.py - APP_PUBLIC_URL env var is read at function call time, not start time. Acceptable; consider documenting that essay URLs in emails depend on APP_PUBLIC_URL being set.

server.py - essay_dispatches indexes are created via create_index([(post_id,1),(recipient_user_id,1)], unique=True). Verified the index prevents duplicate writes in test_dispatch_idempotent_via_direct_invoke.
All new endpoints exclude _id in projections; verified via _no_underscore_id walker on all 24 Phase 5 test responses. No ObjectID leaks.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 94 backend tests pass from clean Mongo state in ~187s. Run: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/ -v. If you see cascading 'KeyError: text' failures in older tests during full runs, it means leftover essay docs in db.posts from a prior killed test - run `mongosh --quiet --eval "use('test_database'); db.posts.deleteMany({kind:'essay'}); db.essay_dispatches.deleteMany({});"` before re-running. The Phase 5 BackgroundTask dispatch path is non-deterministic (FastAPI runs after response); use the 5s poll loop helper _count_essay_dispatches() OR import services.essay_dispatch.dispatch_essay_to_followers directly. Brevo sends are best-effort - BREVO_API_KEY may be unset locally; dispatch rows still get inserted with result_status=None/skipped=true and idempotency still holds. Phase 4 /me/subscription test was updated for the new tiers schema; if you see references to data['price_usd'], update those callers.
rca of the issue: n/a - all new features verified. One pre-existing Phase 4 assertion needed updating because the /api/me/subscription schema legitimately moved from single price_usd/period_days fields to a 'tiers' array to support the unchanged Global $10/mo + $100/yr supporter spec. Test updated; no production bug.
